description.en: Read and write Tencent Docs, Smart Sheets, and workspace files
description.zh: 读写腾讯文档、智能表格与空间文件

auth_hint.en: Open the MCP authorization page, sign in, then copy the token and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 打开 MCP 授权页登录，复制页面上的 Token 并粘贴到下方

description.en: Read, write, search, and manage notes and knowledge bases
description.zh: 笔记与知识库读写、检索与管理

auth_hint.en: Click “Open auth page” to get an API Key and Client ID in IMA (the API Key is shown only once)
auth_hint.zh: 点击「打开授权页」在 IMA 中获取 API Key 与 Client ID（API Key 仅展示一次）

description.en: Manage meetings, recordings, and AI summaries
description.zh: 会议管理、查询、录制与智能纪要

auth_hint.en: Open the authorization page, sign in to Tencent Meeting, then copy the token and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 打开授权页登录腾讯会议，复制页面上的 Token 并粘贴到下方

description.en: Search news and follow trending topics
description.zh: 新闻搜索与热点订阅

auth_hint.en: Sign in on the Tencent News Skills page, generate an API Key, and paste it below (one key per account)
auth_hint.zh: 登录腾讯新闻 Skills 页生成 API Key 并粘贴到下方（每个账号仅一个 Key）

description.en: Sync your bookshelf and reading notes
description.zh: 书架同步与读书笔记

auth_hint.en: Sign in at https://weread.qq.com/r/weread-skills, copy the wrk- API Key, and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 登录 https://weread.qq.com/r/weread-skills 获取 wrk- 开头的 API Key 后粘贴到下方

description.en: Search, read, create, and manage knowledge-base documents
description.zh: 知识库检索、阅读、创建与文档管理

auth_hint.en: Open the Lexiang credentials page, sign in, then copy the company id (company_from) and access token into the fields below
auth_hint.zh: 打开乐享凭证页登录，复制企业标识（company_from）与访问令牌，分别填入下方

description.en: Official MCP: list, upload, download, share, and manage cloud files
description.zh: 官方 MCP：网盘列表、上传、下载、分享与文件管理

auth_hint.en: Open the Weiyun Skill setup page, sign in, copy the MCP Token, and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 打开微云 Skill 配置页登录，复制 MCP Token 并粘贴到下方

description.en: Connect QQ Mail, NetEase Mail, Gmail, and others over IMAP/SMTP
description.zh: 通过 IMAP/SMTP 连接 QQ 邮箱、网易邮箱、Gmail 等

auth_hint.en: Pick your mail provider, enable IMAP/SMTP in the mailbox settings, generate an authorization code, and fill it in below
auth_hint.zh: 选择邮箱服务商，在邮箱设置中开启 IMAP/SMTP 并生成授权码后填入下方

description.en: Search songs, charts, playlists, and listening reports
description.zh: 搜歌、排行榜、歌单与听歌报告

auth_hint.en: Sign in on the QQ Music Skills page, generate a qmk- API Key, and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 登录 QQ 音乐 Skills 页生成 qmk- 开头的 API Key 并粘贴到下方

description.en: Smart search for flights, hotels, attractions, and itineraries
description.zh: 机票、酒店、景点与行程智能搜索

auth_hint.en: Sign in to the Fliggy AI Open Platform console, copy the API Key, and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 登录飞猪 AI 开放平台控制台获取 API Key 并粘贴到下方

description.en: Place search, route planning, and weather
description.zh: 地点检索、路线规划与天气查询

auth_hint.en: Get a Token from the Baidu Maps Agent Plan console (starts with sk-ap-) and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 在百度地图 Agent Plan 控制台获取 Token（sk-ap- 开头）并粘贴到下方

description.en: Q&A and recommendations for hotels, flights, and trips
description.zh: 酒店、机票与行程问答推荐

auth_hint.en: Open the Wendao authorization page, copy the Token, and paste it below (the upstream does not reject invalid tokens — copy the full value)
auth_hint.zh: 打开携程问道授权页获取 Token 并粘贴到下方（上游不校验无效 Token，请确认复制完整）

description.en: Q&A for hotels, flights, trains, attractions, and itineraries
description.zh: 酒店、机票、火车票、景点与行程问答

auth_hint.en: Get a Token from the Meituan personal developer page and paste it below (probe only checks the format; real availability is verified when tools are called)
auth_hint.zh: 在美团个人开发者页面获取 Token 并粘贴到下方（探测仅校验格式；真实可用性在对话调用时验证）

description.en: Ride estimates and booking, place search, and trip routing
description.zh: 网约车预估/叫车、地点检索与出行路线规划

auth_hint.en: Open the DiDi developer console, sign in, activate your personal MCP Key, and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 打开滴滴开发者控制台登录并激活个人 MCP Key，复制后粘贴到下方

description.en: Laws, case documents, company data, and legal hallucination checks
description.zh: 法律法规、案例文书、企业信息与法律幻觉检测

auth_hint.en: Sign in to the Yuandian open platform, copy the sk_ API Key, and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 登录元典开放平台获取 sk_ 开头的 API Key 并粘贴到下方

description.en: One-click OAuth or paste an API Key to query companies, risk, IP, operations, and executives
description.zh: 一键 OAuth 或粘贴 API Key，接入企业、风险、知识产权、经营及董监高五类数据

auth_hint.en: Use one-click OAuth when Octop has public HTTPS or localhost; otherwise open the authorization page, copy the API Key, and paste it. Query scope follows your account permissions.
auth_hint.zh: 有公网 HTTPS 或本机 localhost 时可用一键 OAuth；否则打开授权页获取 API Key 后粘贴。查询范围以账户权限为准。

description.en: Official Tencent design-platform MCP: read/write drafts, design systems, and export
description.zh: 腾讯设计平台官方 MCP：设计稿读写、设计系统与导出

auth_hint.en: Click Authorize to sign in to Ardot (saved automatically), or paste a token from the docs
auth_hint.zh: 点击「一键授权」完成 Ardot 登录（成功后自动保存），或按文档手动粘贴 Token

description.en: Official MCP: create, search, organize, and manage notes
description.zh: 官方 MCP：笔记创建、搜索、整理与管理

auth_hint.en: Click “Open auth page”, sign in to the MCP platform, create an API Key under API management, and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 点击「打开授权页」登录 MCP 平台，在 API 管理创建 API Key 并粘贴到下方

description.en: Official MCP: search and read/write pages and databases
description.zh: 官方 MCP：搜索、读写页面与数据库

auth_hint.en: Click Authorize to sign in to Notion (saved automatically), or paste a token from the official docs
auth_hint.zh: 点击「一键授权」完成 Notion 登录（成功后自动保存），或按官方文档手动获取 Token

description.en: Official MCP: search scholarly works, citations, research entities, and statistics
description.zh: 官方 MCP：检索学术文献、引文、研究实体与统计分析

auth_hint.en: Click Authorize to sign in to OpenAlex (use the system browser on desktop). Queries use your own API Key and daily quota.
auth_hint.zh: 点击「一键授权」登录 OpenAlex（桌面端请用系统浏览器）；查询将使用你自己的 API Key 与每日预算。

description.en: Official MCP: tasks, lists, habits, and focus records
description.zh: 官方 MCP：任务、清单、习惯与专注记录

auth_hint.en: Click Authorize to sign in (saved automatically), or create a token under Avatar → Settings → Account and Security → API Token and paste it
auth_hint.zh: 点击「一键授权」完成登录（成功后自动保存），或在网页版「头像 → 设置 → 账户与安全 → API 口令」创建并粘贴 Token

description.en: Use the official lark-cli for docs, Bitable, calendar, and messages (host CLI required)
description.zh: 通过官方 lark-cli 操作文档、多维表格、日历与消息（需主机安装 CLI）

auth_hint.en: Enter the Feishu app App ID and App Secret; document search also needs Authorize
auth_hint.zh: 填写飞书应用 App ID 与 App Secret；文档搜索需再点「登录授权」

description.en: Use the official wecom-cli for docs, calendar, and messages (host CLI required)
description.zh: 通过官方 wecom-cli 操作文档、日程与消息（需主机安装 CLI）

auth_hint.en: Enter the long-connection smart bot Bot ID and Secret; the host must have @wecom/cli (wecom-cli) installed
auth_hint.zh: 填写长连接智能机器人 Bot ID 与 Secret；主机需已安装 @wecom/cli（wecom-cli）

description.en: Use an independent Agent mailbox through the official CLI, with mail, attachments, device authorization and two-phase confirmation.
description.zh: 通过官方 CLI 使用独立的 Agent 邮箱，支持邮件与附件、设备码授权和两阶段确认。

auth_hint.en: Save the connector, then authorize it. Each instance binds an independent mailbox.
auth_hint.zh: 先保存连接器，再完成设备码授权；每个实例独立绑定邮箱

description.en: Search, read, and write notes in a vault via the official Obsidian CLI (Obsidian must be running on this host)
description.zh: 通过官方 Obsidian CLI 搜索、阅读和写入指定库中的笔记（需本机运行 Obsidian）

auth_hint.en: Enter the vault name shown in the Obsidian sidebar. Octop and Obsidian must run on the same host, with Command line interface enabled.
auth_hint.zh: 填写 Obsidian 侧边栏中的库名。Octop 与 Obsidian 需在同一台主机，并已启用 Command line interface。

help.en: The vault name in the Obsidian sidebar, not a folder path
help.zh: Obsidian 侧边栏显示的库名，不是文件夹路径

help.en: Leave empty if obsidian is already on PATH
help.zh: PATH 中已有 obsidian 时可留空

description.en: Search, read, and write Yuque books and docs via the official Yuque MCP server (stdio)
description.zh: 通过官方语雀 MCP（本地进程 stdio）检索、读写知识库与文档

auth_hint.en: Create a personal token on the Yuque open platform and paste it below
auth_hint.zh: 在语雀开放平台创建个人令牌并粘贴到下方

description.en: Connect a private WeKnora knowledge base for read-only search and document reading
description.zh: 连接 WeKnora 私有知识库，提供只读检索与文档阅读

auth_hint.en: Enter the WeKnora service URL. Fill in API Key and Tenant ID according to your deployment’s auth settings.
auth_hint.zh: 填写 WeKnora 服务地址；API Key 与 Tenant ID 按部署的鉴权设置填写。

help.en: Octop appends /api/v1 when the URL does not already include it
help.zh: 未包含 /api/v1 时会自动补齐

placeholder.en: sk-... (leave empty if the deployment has no auth)

help.en: Required when a platform-level API Key must target a workspace
help.zh: 平台级 API Key 需要指定工作空间时填写

help.en: Leave empty to search every knowledge base visible to this credential
help.zh: 留空时检索当前凭证可见的全部知识库

description.en: Connect the MCP endpoint of a published Dify app or workflow
description.zh: 连接 Dify 已发布应用或工作流的 MCP 服务

auth_hint.en: Enable MCP on the Dify app access point, then paste the full MCP Server URL.
auth_hint.zh: 在 Dify 应用的访问点中启用 MCP，然后粘贴完整的 MCP Server URL。

help.en: Full URL including the access id; stored encrypted
help.zh: 完整 URL 含访问标识，将按密钥加密保存
